bias.en: Turning bearish · closed below the 100 and 200-day
bias.zh: 转弱 · 收于 100 日和 200 日均线下方

read.en: Meta fell 1.9% on Oct 26 to $630.56, trading between $627.82 and $647.69 on 1.6 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($662.8) and 10-day ($696.5), the rising 30-day ($714.2), and just below the rising 100-day ($630.9) and 200-day ($632.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($736.07), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: Meta 10月26日下跌 1.9%，收于 $630.56，盘中区间 $627.82–647.69，成交量为平均水平的 1.6 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$662.8）和 10 日（$696.5）及上行的 30 日均线（$714.2）下方，并略低于上行的 100 日（$630.9）和 200 日均线（$632.5）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$736.07），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The close broke $633–639.7 support and slipped under the 100 and 200-day, now resistance. Resistance is $630.9–639.7 (100 and 200-day, Oct 22 low), then $647.7–648 (Oct 23 and 26 highs) and $662.8 (5-day). Support is $627.8 (Oct 26 low), then $612.4 (Aug 11 high) and $600 (Jan 20 low). A close below $627.8 would open $600–612; a close back above $639.7 would target $648.

r.en: 100 and 200-day averages ($630.9–632.5); Oct 22 low $639.7, now resistance
